events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Deni Avdija scored 27 points, Caleb Love and Shaedon Sharpe added 20 apiece off the bench and the Portland Trail Blazers snapped a three-game losing streak, beating the Cleveland Cavaliers 122-110 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deni Avdija scores 27 points to help the Trail Blazers beat the Cavaliers 122-110

headlines.description: — Jamal Murray scored a season-high 52 points and Nikola Jokic fell just short of another triple-double to help the Denver Nuggets hold off the short-handed Indiana Pacers 135-120 on Wednesday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jamal Murray scores season-high 52 points, Nuggets hold off Pacers 135-120

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Orlando Magic

headlines.description: — Luke Kornet blocked Franz Wagner's last-second layup, De’Aaron Fox scored 31 points and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Orlando Magic 114-112 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kornet blocks Wagner's last-second layup as Spurs hold off Magic, 114-112

headlines.description: — James Harden had 27 points and nine assists, and the Los Angeles Clippers ended a five-game losing streak with a 115-92 win over the Atlanta Hawks on Wednesday night in their first game after deciding to move on without Chris Paul.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harden scores 27, Clippers end 5-game skid by beating Hawks after moving on without Paul

events.name: Charlotte Hornets at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Karl-Anthony Towns had 35 points, 18 rebounds and five assists, Jalen Brunson scored 26 points and the New York Knicks beat the Charlotte Hornets 119-104 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Towns, Brunson carry the Knicks to a 119-104 victory over the Hornets

headlines.description: — Michael Porter Jr. had 33 points and 10 rebounds and the Brooklyn Nets won consecutive games for the first time this season, beating the depleted Chicago Bulls 113-103 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porter scores 33 points to lead Nets past Bulls 113-103 for their 2nd straight win

headlines.description: — Alperen Sengun had 28 points and 10 rebounds, Kevin Durant scored 24 points and the Houston Rockets beat the Sacramento Kings 121-95 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sengun, Durant lead Rockets to 121-95 victory over the Kings

headlines.shortLinkText: Bucks lose Antetokounmpo to injury early but rally past Pistons 113-109

headlines.description: — Cooper Flagg scored 22 points, Anthony Davis had 17 points and 17 rebounds and the Dallas Mavericks extended their first winning streak of the season to three games with a 118-108 victory over the Miami Heat on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Flagg and the Mavs extend their 1st winning streak to 3 with win over Heat
